# Vistex

> > Enterprise software solutions for revenue management, pricing optimization, and partner incentive programs, with deep SAP integration and cloud-native applications.

Vistex provides comprehensive revenue management and margin optimization solutions across life sciences, high-tech, manufacturing, and media industries. The company offers SAP-certified extensions including SAP Extended Price Management, SAP Data Maintenance, and SAP Price Staging Hub, alongside cloud-native platforms like GTMS for rights and royalties management and RevFlo for Salesforce integration.

## Key Topics

- SAP S/4HANA integration
- Revenue management and margin optimization
- Partner incentive programs and channel rewards
- Pricing solutions and rebate management
- Life sciences gross-to-net and compliance
- SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform)
- Salesforce CPQ and revenue integration
- Rights and royalties management (GTMS)
- Marketing development funds (MDF)
- AI-driven price optimization
- Partner engagement and loyalty
- Medical device pricing transparency
- SAP Pinnacle Award recognition
- Go-to-market strategy optimization

## Core Solutions

- [SAP Margin Optimization Solutions](https://www.vistex.com/solutions-sap): SAP S/4HANA margin optimization and pricing solutions via SAP BTP
- [Salesforce Revenue Management App](https://www.vistex.com/solutions/cloud-extensions/salesforce-revenue-management-app): RevFlo Salesforce integration for pricing, CPQ, and revenue management
- [GTMS Rights and Royalties for Music](https://www.vistex.com/resources/music-rights-royalties-cloud-software): GTMS cloud software for music rights and royalty management

## API and Technical Reference

- [API Documentation](https://www.vistex.com/api): REST API documentation for GTMS and SAP ERP integration
